name: @tuucho/plugin-tuucho-payment-stripe
description: Card, PayPal, Bancontact, Google Pay and Apple Pay via Stripe.

publishableKey.label: Publishable key
publishableKey.description: pk_test_… or pk_live_… from the Stripe Dashboard. Safe to show in the browser; required for Checkout.
publishableKey.sectionDescription: Dashboard keys. Use test keys until you take live payments. Secrets are never shown after save.

secretKey.label: Secret key
secretKey.description: sk_test_… or sk_live_…. The kernel charges with this key. Type a new value only to replace it.

webhookSecret.label: Webhook secret
webhookSecret.description: whsec_… from the Stripe webhook endpoint. Required so payment events are verified. Leave empty to keep the stored secret.

requestTimeout.label: Request timeout
requestTimeout.description: How long a Stripe API call may wait (for example 12s) before checkout fails the attempt.
requestTimeout.sectionDescription: How long the kernel waits on Stripe and how long a one-time card stays on file.

paymentAuthExpirySpyBefore.label: Auth-expiry spy lead time
paymentAuthExpirySpyBefore.description: How early staff get a spy mail before an uncaptured payment authorization expires (for example 2d).

oneTimeCardRetentionDays.label: One-time card retention (days)
oneTimeCardRetentionDays.description: Days to keep a card used once, then drop it. Raise only if you need longer replay for failed captures.
